liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **So Many Roads** (3 reviews): Reviewer calls this performance their favorite version of the song, noting it brings tears; Jerry's soulful performance at the song's end is highlighted as possibly the best ever [18][23][25]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Jerry plays a MIDI flute at 11:25, prompting Phil to immediately start the Fire bass line [24]
- **Fire on the Mountain** (1 review): Jerry's passionate singing, despite some flubbed lyrics, is cited as a key highlight of the track [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-10-01.132503.nak300.andrewf.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 190 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1994-10-01.fob.schoeps.evans-gross.GEMS.77223.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 197 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1994-10-01.schoeps.GEMS.77224.flac1648**: source not stated; 22 songs; 197 min [3]
- **gd94-10-01.sbd.gorinsky.4671.sbeok.shnf**: pre-FM broadcast master; 23 songs; 179 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- The band played with consistent flow throughout the evening at the Boston Garden [18]
- Reviewer, an 18-year-old attending their fifth show, felt the venue was rocking intensely [22]
- The performance is compared to similar songs from Richfield in March 1994 and Detroit in August [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-10-01.132503.nak300.andrewf.flac1644**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Casio DA-7 > TDK DC4 DAT. Mics on 7-foot stand, end of floor, center & straight back by the hockey wall. [1]. Also: Ted Carpenter loaned microphones and a stand for the audience recording run [1]
- **gd1994-10-01.fob.schoeps.evans-gross.GEMS.77223.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Todd Evans & Adam Gross [2]. Also: Set one was remastered seven times to match set two's quality after suffering balance issues [2]
- **gd1994-10-01.schoeps.GEMS.77224.flac1648**: taped by Todd Evans & Adam Gross; transferred by Jamie Waddell; source: FOB Schoeps Mk4 Cardiod Capsule -> Schoeps Active Cables -> Schoeps CMC 6 Mic Body -> Apogee AD500e -> CASIO DA-R100 [3]. Also: Set one required extensive remastering to mirror set two's superior balance and tonal quality [3]
- **gd94-10-01.sbd.gorinsky.4671.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> Dat> CDR (Pre-Fm GDH Discs) > CDR > EAC (Secure Mode, Test and Copy) > SHN [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Boston Garden - October 1, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/october-1-1994) [28]
- Poster by www.photog.com: [Jim Anderson's Grateful Dead Photography at The Boston Garden MA 1 October 1994 page 1 of 2](https://www.photog.com/gdead/90s/94/10-01/) [29]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 10/1/94 Boston Garden, Boston, …](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295845381/) [30]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295845381/) [31]
